author: Forbes
description:
Live events are more expensive than ever, but Feld Entertainment CEO Juliette Feld Grossman knows exactly how to keep audiences coming back. As the third-generation leader of the family business behind Ringling Bros. and Barnum & Bailey, Disney on Ice, and Monster Jam, Juliette oversees over 3,000 live productions worldwide every year. In this episode of C-Suite Unscripted, she sits down with host Maggie McGrath to discuss the massive consumer-driven changes brought to the modern circus, how the company uses AI to track and engineer Monster Jam truck damage, and the upcoming launch of Disney Live for preschoolers.

author: Forbes
description:
For Albert Bourla, who was born and raised in Greece before he moved to New York, being the CEO of Pfizer is a reality that could have been achieved only in America.

Bourla sat down with Senior Editor Maggie McGrath to discuss how his professional journey was shaped by his immigrant experience and how he is leading Pfizer through pivotal developments in oncology. He also shares why he thinks the U.S. continues to be one of the most attractive countries for immigrants and why he has an optimistic attitude toward life and opportunity in America.
